name: travel-reality-copilot
description: A participatory AI travel-planning capability pack that coordinates route, discovery, lodging, dining, itinerary arrangement and reality validation without taking decisions away from the traveler.

interface.shortDescription: Build executable, personal itineraries through traveler-led decisions
interface.longDescription: Turn incomplete travel intent into a route, selected experiences, lodging, dining and daily movement through progressive decisions. The Agent stops at meaningful trade-offs and keeps uncertain live facts visible as verification work.
defaultPrompt: Plan this trip with me step by step instead of generating everything at once.
Organize my saved places into a route without silently removing my choices.
验证这份行程是否真的走得通，并把最终决定权留给我。
